notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 Auto Provide surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, Auto Provide FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies the standard Auto Provide switch, ordinary publication and subscription, provider-owned object discovery, one grouped provideAttributeValueUpdate solicitation with the complete owned attribute set and empty user tag, and independent subscription and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Auto Provide switch, ordinary object publication, subscription, registration, unsubscription, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador discovery and provideAttributeValueUpdate callbacks
